init.title: Hestia Energy
init.description:
Everything is set in the Energy tab of the Hestia-FB panel.

[Open the Energy tab]({link})

set_settings.name: Set the contract
set_settings.description: Changes the off-peak hours, the prices or the contract option, as in Settings. For an offer Hestia does not know, an automation can follow its seasons.

offer.name: Price of a kWh
offer.description: bleu: EDF's regulated tariff; autre: the prices given here.

offpeak.name: Off-peak hours
offpeak.description: One or more ranges, for example "00:00-07:00, 13:00-16:00".

offpeak_weekend.name: Weekends and public holidays
offpeak_weekend.description: tout: off-peak all day; pareil: the same hours as on weekdays.

price_hp.name: Peak price
price_hp.description: In euros per kWh, with the « autre » offer.

price_hc.name: Off-peak price
price_hc.description: In euros per kWh, with the « autre » offer.

price_base.name: Base price
price_base.description: In euros per kWh, with the « autre » offer.

subscription.name: Subscription
subscription.description: In euros a year, with the « autre » offer.

battery_soc.name: Battery charge
battery_soc.description: The home battery's sensor in %, when Hestia did not find the right one.

battery_kwh.name: Battery capacity
battery_kwh.description: In usable kWh, when the one Hestia learned is not right.
